sections.text: Stop the Motor and Isolate its CB
Tighten loosen bolts.

Check ground wire and tighten if
necessary .

Clean outside of motor and ventilation
air inlets .

Measure windings installation resistance
not to be less than 15 MΩ .

Inspect the motor interior if it very
dirty disassemble the motor and clean .
Wipe the commutator with a clean canvas .

Inspect the fit of the brushes to the
commutator. If the commutator has a rough surface, it must be smoothed with a 
piece of sand paper

Remove the inlet and outlet plugs and
grease the bearings with (dolium-R grease) , then replace the inlet plug .

Run the motor for 10 min before 
replacing the outlet grease plug
Recheck the running condition.
